title: Activity week, schema version 1
description: One ISO week of the owner's Slack messages, written by services/allocation-agent (collect) to <out-dir>/<week>.json and read by services/timesheet-core. ADR-0011. Readers ignore unknown fields, so adding an optional field keeps schema_version 1; removing, renaming or retyping a field needs schema_version 2.

slack_user_id.description: Slack member id whose messages these are.

rfc3339.description: RFC 3339 date-time with a UTC offset (Z or +hh:mm).

channel_name.description: Channel name without #; empty when the source did not return one (for example a DM).

posted_at.description: The ts as a date-time in the configured timezone, whole seconds.

permalink.description: Message permalink; empty when the source did not return one.

thread_ts.description: Parent ts for a thread reply, otherwise null.
